name: Yulan
fandom: Avatar: The Last Airbender / Jasmine After Rain

identity.role: Cart driver and road mechanic who maintains the cart taking Iroh and Jasper through the hills

grounded_traits: attentive to descent and load safety
personality.voice: Short practical corrections grounded in weather, slopes, pins, and repair work; she neither needs Iroh's admiration nor humiliates him to show skill.

relationships.Iroh: Corrects his proposed timber brace, asks him to hold a lantern lower, and installs her packed iron pin.
relationships.Jasper: Trusts him to chock the wheel while she works.

source_boundary: Story-original. Never claim Yulan is Avatar franchise canon or grant her knowledge of future Threadways without a scene.
writer_rules: Keep this character's livelihood and decisions independent of Jasper's romantic arcs.
Maintain first-person Jasper perception; do not invent unseen knowledge.
No additional romantic or sensual role is implied.
